title: Board drawings, fixed
lede: Every board now draws at its true proportions, zone labels stop piling up, and picking a zone works by click or tap, not just hover.

sections.heading: Side by side
sections.note: Before is the page after the internal-use cut, captured earlier today. After differs only by this change. Same manifest (2026-10-08.1), Chromium, light mode, 1× scale, and the same viewport and clip.

changes.was: The drawing's height came from a percentage that resolved against the card, not the narrowed figure. Anything not much wider than tall was stretched tall.
changes.now: A sizer inside the figure carries the aspect ratio. Tall boards cap at 260 px; ribbons stay at least 8 px.

changes.was: Alternative layouts of one area (Frame-Left around the wing and ads; Two Thirds around 1080s) all centered their labels in the same spot.
changes.now: A zone that holds others labels its top-left corner. If the zones inside fill more than half of it, its label shows only on hover or pick.

changes.was: Partly overlapping zones printed labels over each other.
changes.now: After layout (and on every resize), a label that would overlap a smaller zone's label hides until hovered.

changes.was: Highlighting only worked on hover, so touch got nothing; clicking a zone scrolled the list to center it.
changes.now: Click or tap a zone or its row to pick it. Full-board zones (Fullscreen, Borders) outline the whole board. The list scrolls only as far as needed. Escape clears the pick.

changes.was: Search matches and hover shared one class, so leaving a row in search mode left its zone lit. Hover and pick repeated the same lookup. There were two one-line aliases (cardId, boardCount).
changes.now: Search matches use their own class. One eachZone helper serves hover and pick. The aliases are gone.

verification: npm run verify:docs (exit 0) and git diff --check: pass

Playwright: row hover lights its zone and clears on leave; clicking a zone picks it and its row; clicking a row picks it; Escape clears; picking Borders lights .zone-whole; ?q=1920x1080 marks 3 drawn zones and 3 rows; no page errors
All 27 drawings across the five venues captured after the final change and checked by eye, light mode; picked states also checked in dark mode
Corner labels: only Club Board shows them (1080 Left, 1080 Right); none at Kohl Center, Field House, LaBahn or Goodman
notes: Ribbon boards (fascias, the 360 Fascia) draw at the 8 px minimum, so their zones carry no labels; the list below names them. A zoom-on-hover for ribbons would be the next geometry improvement.
Not done: search by id or key, and Back-button history.
